title: The Nutcracker
description: See Philadelphia Ballet's George Balanchine's The Nutcracker.

advanceSteps.title: Select one roll of Life Savers per child

checklist: Take picture with Sugar Plum Fairy
Reflect on any differences we noticed in the performance this year
Observe whether Nutcracker stabbed Mouse King in back or had an honorable victory
Count the number of candy cane hula hoop spins in peak jump
Shout bravo when the conductor gets on the stage during curtain call

variants.name: Amphitheatre
variants.description: The top tier, farthest from the stage.

variants.name: Balcony
variants.description: The middle tiers, with a full view of the stage.

variants.name: Parquet
variants.description: The orchestra level, closest to the stage.
